# loans/ (PRD-03 — loan module)

## Endpoints

### Loans CRUD
- `GET /api/accounting/loans` — list (`?status=active|closed|written_off`, `?product=bond|...`)
- `POST /api/accounting/loans` — create; body = `LoanCreateInput`; returns 201
- `GET /api/accounting/loans/[id]` — detail (404 if not caller's company)
- `PATCH /api/accounting/loans/[id]` — partial update; writable fields: `status`, `glAccountId`, `reference`, `description`

### Per-loan resources
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/loans/[id]/schedule` — GET computes+caches by inputs-hash (`{ rows, runId, cached, computedAt }`); POST dry-run with optional `{ events? }` override (not persisted)
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/loans/[id]/events` — list / add event (`LUMP|SKIP|RESTRUCTURE|WRITEOFF`); LUMP requires `amount>0`
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/loans/[id]/gl-postings` — list postings / post period `{ period: number }`; blocks when `nca_flagged` or period locked
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/loans/[id]/compliance` — assessment history / run assessment `{ asOfDate? }`
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/loans/[id]/payments` — record payment `{ paymentDate, periodNumber, bankAccountId? }`; splits P+I, posts GL, UNIQUE per `(company, loan, period_number)` — second call throws "already recorded"

### Portfolio + period close
- `GET /api/accounting/loans/portfolio/summary` — KPIs; `totalOutstanding` is ACTUAL (principal − `loan_payments.principal`); weighted rate by actuals
- `GET /api/accounting/loans/portfolio/rate-sensitivity` — IFRS 7 ±100bp / ±200bp shock on next-12m interest
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/loans/period-close` — `?month=&year=` list with status / POST `{ loanIds, month, year }` posts accrual+reclassification journals

## Auth
- Top-level `index.ts`, `[id].ts`, `period-close.ts`: `withAuth(withErrorHandler(withCsrf(withWriteAccess(handler))))`
- `[id]/*.ts` and `portfolio/*.ts`: `withAuth(withErrorHandler(withWriteAccess(handler)))` — CSRF not applied, write-access gate still enforced on mutating methods
- Read-only portfolio summary: `withAuth(withErrorHandler(handler))`

## Business rules
- **Route precedence**: `portfolio/summary.ts` + `portfolio/rate-sensitivity.ts` are static routes one level deeper than `[id]`; Next.js resolves them before `[id]/...`
- **Period-close idempotency**: second POST to `/loan-periods/:yyyymm/close` returns 500 "already locked" — treat as success on recovery
- **GL posting prerequisites**: loan must have all five account FKs (`gl_account_id`, `interest_expense_account_id`, `interest_payable_account_id`, `bank_account_id`, `current_portion_account_id`) set — service throws before creating any entry
- **Payment-date normalisation**: format schedule-row dates via local getters (`getFullYear/getMonth/getDate`) NOT `.toISOString()`. UTC conversion under SAST shifts first-of-month back one day → `postJournalEntry` rejects with "Cannot post to closed fiscal period"
- `loan_payments` required `GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON loan_payments TO app_user` after mig 400 (portfolio summary 500'd)
